## Critique
- claim-1: Unsupported. No verbatim text, stable physical line locators, provenance record, or task-owned excerpt digest is supplied, so neither the artifact’s alleged contents nor coverage of all fifteen cases can be verified.
- claim-2: Correctly states the resulting limitation: the named source certificate is not established on the supplied evidence. The strategy appropriately avoids inventing missing text or metadata.

## Repair certificates
- [source-refresh] Persist a task-owned, line-addressable verbatim excerpt of `research-attempt-research-plan-task-68-1` covering its opening hypotheses, equation (1), and every one of the fifteen cases in equation/table (4), and provide its immutable source identifier, stable line locators, provenance linking it to the inspected source, and artifact digest.

## Required revisions
- Remove or substantiate claim-1’s assertion that artifact `a9a23cc19066d783e0dd3ceeaf7177e7676f1c1af49d060e8ac00df787207c67` contains the requested material.
- Conclude only that the source certificate remains unestablished; make no parent-theorem claim.
